title: Velvety Midnight Stew
description: A hearty stew made with tender Canadian beef and rich velvety sauce.

ingredients.name: stir
ingredients.notes: no need for this ingredient, it's just for the name

instructions: 1. Heat the midnight oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the Canadian beef to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the chopped tomato to the pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
4. Pour in the velvety sauce and stir to combine.
5. Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours.
6. Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve the Velvety Midnight Stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
